notes.title: Extinction Rifts has been released! Play now!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963847/19bb68a4ac65e9eeb8ca1428233cc05b634d9fd6.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]The wait is over, Monolith Slayer. [/h1][h1]The chaos is here.[/h1][p]Extinction Rifts is finally unleashed, and now it’s your turn to step into the fight. Load your weapons, charge your glove, and dive into a world where every punch shatters the battlefield.[/p][h3]Humanity’s survival isn’t a plan. It’s a war. And the monoliths won’t stop until we’re extinct.[/h3][p]Get in, tear them down, and show the enemy what happens when there’s no gum left.[/p][h3]But here’s the twist: it’s not just about surviving. [/h3][p]Our leaderboard is live, and every fighter in the world is gunning for the top spot. Want to prove you’re the one who crushes more than anyone else? Then it’s time to grind, climb, and dominate.[/p][h3]The enemies won’t wait and neither will your rivals. [/h3][p]Jump in now and claim your place among the legends.[/p]

notes.title: Extinction Rifts in the Made in Brazil Sale 💥
notes.content:
Calling all combo seekers! 

Important transmission: From today until [b]March 4th[/b], Extinction Rifts is part of the [b]Made in Brazil Sale[/b]! An unmissable event featuring incredible Brazilian games 💥 

[b]What awaits you in [b]Extinction Rifts[/b]?
[/b]
⚡ Fast-paced combat and arcade gameplay
🎮 A combo-based FPS – the more you hit, the stronger you get!
🕵️‍♂️ Hidden secrets scattered across the levels
🔫 Varied special abilities and weapons for different play styles
💀 Stack insane combos to unleash the Extinction Punch, wiping out the level at once!
🏆 High replayability with multiple ranks to achieve
🔄 Multiple endings
🎯 Play your way – mastering combos is key, but not mandatory to beat the game!

 See you at the top of the leaderboard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963847/86f598636aa5c1fe2444223f72fbcefdf1a34836.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hey everyone! All good? 🔥

Today’s message is quick—no time to drop the combo! 

We’re thrilled to announce that Extinction Rifts will be part of Steam Next Fest with an exclusive demo! From February 24 to March 3, you’ll get to dive into this action-packed adventure, taking down enemies, uncovering secret items, leveling up your combo, and destroying monoliths!

[previewyoutube=je53kd2QV2E;full][/previewyoutube]

💥 But wait, there’s more 💥

To make sure you get the most out of it, the Extinction Rifts demo is available TODAY! 🎯 That’s right, before the event even begins, you can already experience this FPS inspired by the classics of the PS1 era!

Make sure to follow us on social media to share your feedback and chat with us (about the game or anything else, we love a good conversation 😆)

👉 [url=https://discord.gg/qubyte]Join us on Discord![/url]

See you soon... it’s time for mayhem!

notes.title: Sign up for the Extinction Rifts Steam Playtest now
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=uMxgPQ_Mc2c;full][/previewyoutube]
Hi everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce the start of the playtest for Extinction Rifts, our new boomer shooter bursting with action Inspired by classic shooters, Extinction Rifts is a fast-paced FPS where your power grows as your combo increases. 

Blast your way through secret enemy headquarters and destroy the Ancient Monoliths with your devastating gauntlet! 💥

This is your chance to help shape the game and be among the first to experience the thrill of Extinction Rifts. The playtest runs from August 28th to September 2nd, so don’t miss out!

👉 Sign up here to join the playtest:
https://tinyurl.com/ExtinctionPlaytest


Don't forget to check your email for your game key! 📧 We also want to hear from you, so please join our Discord community to give feedback and share your thoughts on the game. Your feedback is crucial to making Extinction Rifts the best it can be!

👉 Join our Discord here:
https://www.discord.gg/qubyte
